items.name: Capivara Alto da XV Mall 2025

venue.name: [Alto da XV Mall](https://www.altodaxvmall.com.br/)
venue.address: R. Camões, 601 - Alto da XV, Curitiba - PR, 80045-320

items.information:
**(Português) Brasileiro**
Sejam todos bem-vindos à terceira competição no Alto da XV Mall em parceria com o Capivara!

Sua inscrição só será aprovada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento correto, que deverá ser efetuado de forma antecipada - mais informações abaixo em "Requisitos para inscrição". Se tiver dificuldades em se inscrever, veja como fazer neste [vídeo](https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8?si=OQ1vLrsJVqagiDna).

É muito importante que você conheça todo o regulamento, pois penalidades serão aplicadas rigorosamente de acordo com ele. O regulamento pode ser lido [aqui](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian/).


**English**
Welcome to the third competition at Alto da XV Mall in partnership with Capivara!

Your registration will only be approved in the WCA website after payment confirmation, which must be made in advance - more information below in "Registration requirements". If you have any problem on how to register, take a look at this [video](https://youtu.be/dZQiw5v8Bm0?si=Sq18haJ3WPk2AG82).

It is very important that you know the regulations, since penalties will be applied precisely according to them. The regulations can be read [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).

items.name: Slovenian FMC Nationals 2025
items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBc2xiIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--6e4ca2771e9de59b2b4ec158347f69fed9d1d546/SI.png)

**To je samo FMC tekmovanje slovenskega državnega prvenstva 2025!** Za ostale discipline preverite tekmovanje [Slovenian Nationals 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SlovenianNationals2025).
Tekmovanje organizira Rubik klub Slovenija.
Če potrebujete dodatne informacije ali če bi želeli spremeniti svojo prijavo, nam pišite na **wca.slovenia@gmail.com**.

Za več informacij preverite zavihke!

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBc2hiIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--4e3eff62ae7d9d9a76dea175436b619568f5b8f2/EN.png)

**This competition is recognized as Slovenian Championship 2025!** For other events check competition [Slovenian Nationals 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SlovenianNationals2025).
Competition is being organized by the Rubik klub Slovenija.
If you need any additional information, or if you would like to change your registration, please write an e-mail to the **wca.slovenia@gmail.com**.

For more information, please check the tabs!
